summary: 仕様は最小限(必須制約・受入基準・out of scope・検証手順)に絞り、重複説明・自明事項・変動情報を削る。詳細は正本へlinkし、常時読込文書は短いmapにする。

evidence.summary: Anthropic: 'Keep it concise. For each line, ask: Would removing this cause Claude to make mistakes? If not, cut it. Bloated CLAUDE.md files cause Claude to ignore your actual instructions!'。良いspecは'self-contained: name the files and interfaces involved, state what is out of scope, and end with an end-to-end verification step'。
'Minimum Viable Documentation'、'Prefer the Good Over the Perfect'、bonsaiのように頻繁にtrim。
短い常時mapとtask時詳細読込(OpenAI harness engineering)。
Spec Kit clarifyは質問を最大5問・材料的影響のあるものに限定し、'Only asks when answers materially impact architecture...'。過剰詳細化を抑える設計。
